name: token-economy-default
description: Default rubric for the mcp-schema-linter skill. Reproduces the built-in scoring exactly. Override any subset of sections; omitted sections fall back to these defaults.

1.label: Direct cost drivers
1.description: Each failure has a directly measurable token cost paid on every turn. tokens_saved is measured, not estimated.

2.label: Indirect cost drivers
2.description: Each failure causes routing errors that burn whole turns. tokens_saved is estimated based on typical recovery patterns.

3.label: Hygiene
3.description: Small per-occurrence cost that accumulates across the catalog. tokens_saved is reported as 0; criterion contributes to overall tool quality score.

description_length_appropriate.description: Description sits in the 20-150 token band. Under-description causes router failures; over-description bloats the catalog.

no_boilerplate_opener.description: Description does not open with a generic phrase that adds tokens without information.

schema_compact.description: Input schema is not bloated by deep nesting, redundant unions, or edge-case fields.

no_redundant_examples.description: Examples appear in exactly one place (description OR schema, not both).

concise_parameter_names.description: Parameter names are short and meaningful, not over-descriptive.

has_when_to_use.description: Description includes positive guidance on when to pick this tool.

has_when_not_to_use.description: Description includes negative guidance when siblings exist. N/A if no siblings.

no_overlap_with_siblings.description: Overlapping sibling tools have explicit distinguishing language in each description.

param_format_specified.description: Date, timestamp, ID, and URL parameters state their format. N/A if no applicable parameters.

destructive_action_annotated.description: Mutating tools have both MCP annotations and description language calling out the mutation. N/A for read-only tools.

name_is_verb_oriented.description: Tool name uses an action verb.

name_is_unique_in_catalog.description: No near-synonymous tool names in the catalog.

every_param_has_description.description: No parameter is missing a description.

enum_values_documented.description: Enum parameters list valid values with semantic notes. N/A if no enum parameters.

units_specified.description: Numeric parameters with ambiguous units state them. N/A if no applicable parameters.
